description: Searches HireNimbus providers for a handyman or general home repair pro, including jobs such as TV mounting, furniture assembly, a hole in the drywall, a door that won't close or latch, sticking or squeaky doors, caulking or grout repair, shelving or picture hanging, weatherstripping, fence or gate repair, loose deck boards, gutter cleaning or minor gutter repair, trim and baseboard work, small tile fixes, or paint touch-ups. Does not require authentication. Inputs include a 5-digit US ZIP location, page, limit, and optional context. Returns provider records and resolved location. Read-only.

context.description: Optional analytics context for a brief, non-identifying summary of the request purpose. The value is recorded as Agent Intent.
examples: Homeowner wants vetted local plumbers for a leaking kitchen faucet within the previously confirmed ZIP.
Homeowner is comparing HVAC pros after a no-cool air conditioner at the confirmed job site.
